content:
Alex: Quick async check — doing a milestone sweep for this quarter (runtime-v2 rollout + model-routing). Please reply with one-line status: shipped/slipped, owner, next action, blocker. Aim to finalize handoff doc today. @Priya @Emma
Priya: runtime-v2 -> shipped canary (us-east). owner: Priya. next: gradual rollout 10%->50% today. blocker: infra autoscale tuning ongoing. :thumbsup:
Emma: model-routing -> slipped. owner: Emma. next: finish policy fallback tests then A/B. blocker: flaky test infra, pinging @Jorge.
Jorge: looking into flaky test infra — saw OOMs on staging with long sequences. ETA fix ~4h, temp increase to staging pod mem underway. saw high mem last night in deploy logs.
Kai: product asked for tighter latency SLOs for rollout policy. owner: Kai. next: propose batching config by EOD. blocker: need perf numbers from prod traces.
Sam: product side: shipped dedicated-customer redirect rules. owner: Sam. next: update docs + notify sales ops. blocker: none.
deploy-bot: deploy: runtime-v2 v2.1.0 promoted to us-east canary @2991109000 by CI. smoke tests: pass.
Emma: test infra fix landed, re-running fallback tests now. if green, plan A/B next Tue. :crossed_fingers:
Priya: can we add a quick rollforward plan in case latency rises? I can draft. @Alex approve?
Alex: yes — Priya draft + share link. include rollback steps and monitoring thresholds.
Priya: done, draft posted: https://redwood.docs/s/rollouts/runtime-v2-rollforward
Jorge: staging mem bump applied, fallback tests passed. repro rate down. scheduling longer soak overnight.
Emma: tests green. A/B next Tue, owners lined up. I'll update OKR tracker.
Kai: batching config proposal posted in PR: 
```
max_batch_tokens=1024
prefer_latency_percentile=95
```
sending PR now.
Sam: sales ops notified and doc updated.
Alex: thanks all. I'll mark shipped/slipped in the OKR doc and ping execs after final A/B. if no other blockers, closing this thread in 2h.
